title: Wealth & Asset Management
description: We combine tailored portfolio management with dedicated investment strategies and properly structured investment vehicles.

management.title: Management built around the mandate.
management.lead: Investment objectives differ. So should the approach.
paragraphs: We work with professional investors to understand their objectives, risk appetite, liquidity requirements and investment constraints.
Our approach to wealth management is based on defined mandates, considered portfolio construction and ongoing investment oversight.
For asset managers and investors seeking dedicated investment structures, we provide access to established fund arrangements supported by specialist management and professional services.

fund.title: A fund is more than a portfolio.
fund.lead: An investment strategy needs more than capital and an investment manager.
fund.body: It requires a proper legal structure, defined responsibilities and professional oversight.
fund.name: EMFI Fund SPC
fund.introduction: is a Cayman Islands segregated portfolio company providing a common fund structure for distinct investment portfolios.
fund.detail: Each segregated portfolio has its own investment mandate, assets and applicable portfolio-level arrangements, subject to the company's constitutional documents and relevant offering materials.
fund.networkTitle: A network of professional service providers
fund.networkBody: The fund ecosystem combines EMFI's investment and operational capabilities with specialist administration, audit and legal services. The roles shown below reflect appointments disclosed for relevant portfolio arrangements; appointments and responsibilities may differ between portfolios.
fund.providerNotice: Selected providers and roles appearing in relevant portfolio arrangements. Specific appointments and responsibilities are portfolio-specific and must be confirmed against the relevant fund documentation.

disclosures.title: Fund structure information
disclosures.introduction: is established in the Cayman Islands as a segregated portfolio company and operates within the applicable Cayman Islands regulatory framework.
paragraphs: The structure supports distinct investment portfolios, each subject to its respective investment mandate, governing documents, appointed service providers and eligibility requirements.
Fund investments involve risk, including possible loss of capital. The relevant offering documents contain the full details of each portfolio and its investment terms.
